## Intention

input file: 03_dat_aug.tsv\
outputfile: 06_key_plot_3.png

We want to look at the peritoneal lesions and if there is a difference in gene expressions for the different subtypes compared to the controls.

Load libraries

```{r}
library("tidyverse")
library("here")
```

Load data from 03_data_aug.tsv

```{r}
data_aug <- read_tsv(here("data/03_dat_aug.tsv"))
```

```{r}
data_aug
```

Selecting data regarding peritoneal lesions and the control group "Control peritoneum"

```{r}
peri_data_long <- data_aug |> 
  filter(Lesion_type == "Peritoneal lesion" |
           (Group == "Control" & Tissue == "Peritoneum")
  ) |> 
  select(-Lesion_type,-Tissue) |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(Sample, Tissue_type, Lesion_subtype, Group, Plot_group),
               names_to = "Gene",
               values_to = "Expression")
peri_data_long
```

Making a tibble of control values for the genes

```{r}
control_vals <- peri_data_long |>
  filter(Group == "Control") |>
  select(Gene, control_expr = Expression)
control_vals
```

```{r}

```

Finding the difference between gene expression in the control group vs. the patient subtypes.

```{r}
subtype_diffs <- peri_data_long |>
  filter(Group == "Patient", Lesion_subtype %in% c("Red", "White", "Black")) |>
  left_join(control_vals, by = "Gene") |> 
  group_by(Lesion_subtype, Gene) |>
  summarise(
    subtype_mean = mean(Expression, na.rm = TRUE),
    control_expr = first(control_expr),
    log2_ = abs(subtype_mean - control_expr),
    p_value = t.test(Expression, mu = first(control_expr))$p.value,
    stderror = t.test(Expression, mu = first(control_expr))$stderr,
    dof =  t.test(Expression, mu = first(control_expr))$parameter,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(Lesion_subtype, p_value)

subtype_diffs
```
